KEYBIND_DROP: Put down the sleeping player you carry
ADMIN_TAB_GENERAL_DESC: How long sleeping bodies stay, how far they are drawn and what players can do with them.
ADMIN_C_BODIES_DESC: A player who logs out stays in the world as a sleeping body where they left, and wakes up where the body ended up.
ADMIN_H_DAYS: Bodies of players who logged out longer ago than this are removed.
ADMIN_H_SPAWN_DISTANCE: Sleeping bodies appear when a player comes this close and disappear past it.
ADMIN_H_HIDE_INSTANCES: Players inside a private world (a house or motel room interior) leave no body when they log out and see no bodies while inside.
ADMIN_H_WAKE_ON: Keep the default unless a spawn script calls exports['ai-exitsleeping']:PlayerLoaded() after its own spawn.
ADMIN_C_ACTIONS_DESC: Players can carry a sleeping body, put it into a vehicle seat and take it out again.
ADMIN_H_INTERACT_DISTANCE: How close a player must stand to carry a body or reach a vehicle.
ADMIN_H_MAX_ACTION_DISTANCE: The server refuses a carry or vehicle action from further away than this (against cheats).
ADMIN_H_TRACK: How often the server updates where carried bodies and bodies in vehicles are, so the owner wakes up at the right place.
ADMIN_H_DEBUG: Prints what the script does to the server and client consoles.
ADMIN_TAB_ANIMS_DESC: The lying poses of sleeping bodies and the carry animation.
ADMIN_C_SLEEP_ANIMS_DESC: Every body picks one of these at random; every player sees the same pose.
ADMIN_C_CARRIER_DESC: The animation of the player who carries a body.
ADMIN_C_CARRIED_DESC: The animation of the body on the carrier's shoulder.
ADMIN_H_ANIM_FLAGS: GTA animation flags: 1 loops, 49 loops on the upper body while walking, 33 loops while attached.
ADMIN_C_ATTACH_DESC: Where the carried body sits on the carrier.
ADMIN_H_BONE: Bone index of the carrier the body is attached to (0 = the ped's root).
ADMIN_TAB_AREAS_DESC: Places where no sleeping body is shown, such as interiors or safe zones.
ADMIN_DELETE_AREA_DESC: Sleeping bodies inside this area become visible again.
ADMIN_C_AREA_DESC: Players who log out inside leave no body; bodies put down inside are hidden (the owner still wakes up there).
ADMIN_H_SHAPE: A ball or a cylinder around a centre point, or a polygon from corner points.
ADMIN_H_RADIUS: Metres from the centre to the edge.
ADMIN_H_HEIGHT: Metres up and down the area reaches (cylinder: from the centre; polygon: past its lowest and highest corner).
ADMIN_C_CORNERS_DESC: Walk the border and add a corner at each turn, in order; a polygon needs at least three.
